message: The other day, I was in the kitchen making dinner when I accidentally set off the smoke alarm. 😅 Instead of panicking, I shot a quick message to our family group chat: "Dinner's on fire!" My kids jumped in with all sorts of funny comments, but we also ended up talking about our escape plan and how important it is to check the smoke alarms regularly. It was a good reminder that safety doesn’t have to be stressful; sometimes, it just takes a little chat with your loved ones. How do you keep your family in the loop about safety?
